mechanics.body_shape: read the second stack word into EDX, test it, take one of two arms that each write receiver displacement 0x30 and rewrite the [ESP+0x8] slot, then tail-jump to 0x0083c780. The two arms differ only in the value written at 0x30 and in the EAX the tail is about to discard.

receiver_displacement.0x30: the only displacement the complete listing names through ECX, and the only one the machine-derived receiver record enumerates for this body (receiver.offsets [48], max_offset 48, register ECX, bounds_only true, written_through 2). Written at 0x0084144b with EDX-4 and at 0x00841459 with zero, and READ on no path. No record for this target names the member, so the model calls it a displacement and nothing more.

tail_displacements.0x04: written by the tail 0x0083c788 with the first stack word. Not written by this body.
tail_displacements.0x0c: written by the tail 0x0083c78b with the second stack word. Not written by this body.

mechanics.base_adjustment: 0x00841448 LEA EAX,[EDX + -0x4] forms an address one dword below the second stack word, and that address is what 0x0084144b stores. The body forms no other adjusted base and never dereferences the result. What the address denotes is not established by any record read for this target, and this package does not guess at it.
mechanics.null_behavior: A zero second stack word takes JZ 0x00841457: displacement 0x30 is written with zero (XOR EAX,EAX, not a load), the [ESP+0x8] slot is rewritten with zero, and control tail-jumps to 0x0083c780. The tail is still entered exactly once, so the null path is not an early return.
mechanics.non_null_behavior: A non-zero second stack word biases it down by 4, stores that at 0x30, rewrites the [ESP+0x8] slot with the unchanged word, and tail-jumps to 0x0083c780.

direct_call_1.arguments: three words reach it with the frame untouched: the receiver in ECX, the first stack word at [ESP+0x4] and the second stack word at [ESP+0x8]. The body pushes nothing.

direct_call_1.form: JMP, not CALL. abi_derived.tail_call records present true, form jmp, target 0x0083c780, after_frame_setup false.
direct_call_1.callee_record: none. 0x0083c780 is not a function record of this package and no record for it was read or promoted; it is modelled only far enough to carry the three words and the return word.

direct_call_2.arguments: identical to direct_call_1; this is the other arm's exit, not a second transfer in one call

mechanics.frame_slot_writes: 0x0084144e and 0x0084145c each rewrite [ESP+0x8] with EDX, which neither instruction has modified since 0x00841440. Both stores are therefore value-preserving. They are reproduced in the model, and the model hands the tail the CONTENT OF THE SLOT rather than the parameter, so the slot is load-bearing in the model even though the machine's store changes nothing. The model test records this honestly: deleting both stores from the model still passes every check, because the value the tail reads is the same either way. The only frame slot the body writes is [ESP+0x8]; it performs no store to [ESP+0x4].
